create.name: Dr. Lydia de León
create.bio:
Dr. Lydia de León is a Greek architect and researcher who studies how places and buildings affect the people in them. She trained in architecture at the National Technical University of Athens, took an MSc in Sustainable Environmental Design at the Architectural Association in London, and completed a PhD in geobiology at the University of Ioannina on the effects of geophysical anomalies on living systems. For around fifteen years she has researched why ancient temples were built where they were, measuring earth fields, geometry, materials and celestial alignments at sacred sites.

With her partner, the architect Arturo Ponce de León, she co-founded Geophilia, a design studio and school with bases in Greece, Mexico and Spain that brings sacred geometry and building biology into architecture. She created the Healing Architecture approach and wrote The Power of Sacred Location, based on her doctoral research. She teaches online courses on the sacred science of ancient temples, runs the Return to the Temple membership and temple retreats with Arturo, is on the faculty of Resonance Academy, and teaches a live course, Ancient Temple Codes, on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Power of Sacred Location
books.author: Dr. Lydia Gian de León, Arturo Ponce de León
books.description: Based on Lydia de León's doctoral research, this book looks at why ancient temples were placed where they were, and at the links between earth's magnetic and geophysical fields, sacred sites and the people who visit them. It carries forewords by Nassim Haramein and Dan Winter.

courses.title: Ancient Temple Codes
courses.description: A seven-week live course on The Shift Network that treats ancient temples as integrated designs linking earth energies, sacred geometry, materials and celestial alignment. Sessions combine teaching with guided meditations and temple journeys, and recordings are provided.

courses.title: The Sacred Science of Ancient Temples
courses.description: A self-paced online course on earth's fields, sacred geometry, archaeoastronomy and the design of sacred space, drawn from Lydia's research at temple sites. Lifetime access.

courses.title: Return to the Temple Membership
courses.description: A monthly online membership led by Lydia and Arturo de León that brings sacred geometry, ancient wisdom and modern science into daily spiritual practice. It includes live calls, teachings and a community of members.

free_resources.title: 7 Secrets To Create A Sleep Sanctuary
free_resources.description: A free PDF guide from Lydia and Arturo on arranging a bedroom for restful sleep, covering layout, materials and the wider building environment. It is sent after signing up to the Geophilia newsletter.
